text:
Marta (Growth): quick sync — StratusForge marketplace listing + integration webinar + co-auth blog. critical: final inbound routing + demo sandbox access for qualified leads. who owns which pieces?
Grant (PMM): Ill take the benchmark narrative and webinar slides. thinking a short benchmark showing throughput (tokens/sec) and cost per 100k embedding ops on Dedicated vs Shared. target week of May 25. want a partner promo code for attendees: STRATUS-TRIAL-30.
Rina (PartnerOps): Ill coordinate asset upload to StratusForge. they need logo cert, two screenshots, 3 bullets (<=160 chars) and an integration diagram. partner can deliver assets but asks for a checklist.
Kofi (Content): need assets by May 10 to draft landing + joint post. ask partner PM for a 350-word guest section and one customer quote. Ill include a short tech demo sign-up form for 10 "demo slots" — those registrants should be routed as high intent.
Jules (Sales Ops): routing plan: registration -> webhook -> SFDC lead + enrichment (Clearbit) -> routing rules. want hot leads (demo slot or intent==high) to ping #sd-ops with enrichment summary. sample payload below. Please validate field names vs form.
Jules (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload": {
    "email": "{{email}}",
    "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
    "last_name": "{{last_name}}",
    "company": "{{company}}",
    "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
    "company_size": "{{company_size}}",
    "primary_use_case": "{{primary_use_case}}",
    "demo_slot": "{{demo_slot}}",
    "utm_source": "stratusforge",
    "utm_campaign": "stratusforge_integration_may25",
    "partner_tag": "stratusforge",
    "request_enrichment": "true"
  }
}
```
Marta (Growth): note — "demo_slot" == true should escalate to SDRs immediately and apply promo code STRATUS-TRIAL-30 via post-registration email. Rina, can partner approve promo/terms?
Rina (PartnerOps): partner ok with promo code but requests legal signoff on trial terms; they also want demo sandbox API keys for vetted attendees only. Ill collect required MOU items.
Sana (Legal): flag: need signed partner trial terms + logo license + quote approval before we publish. also need explicit consent language for sandbox API key issuance and data processing. Rina please get partner to sign by May 8.
Kofi (Content): landing will include hidden fields for utm_campaign & partner_tag, consent checkbox for sandbox access, and a one-question micro-survey: "Primary use case (select)". Ill draft copy by May 3.
Grant (PMM): benchmark ask: internal micro-run for throughput & cost. Kofi, can you include one chart (throughput vs sequence length) and a short table? Ill deliver numbers by May 7.
Jules (Sales Ops): enrichment flow: after webhook SFDC lead create, call enrichment job (Clearbit) to add industry, funding_stage. routing rules: if demo_slot==true OR intent==high -> assign to Demo SDR queue and post to #sd-ops: "HOT LEAD (StratusForge): <name> - <company> - <title> - demo_slot:true - <sfdc link>". else -> nurture sequence. Also daily digest to #partner-digest with counts and top use-cases.
Marta (Growth): timeline checklist: Rina get partner checklist & sandbox terms to Sana by May 8; Kofi landing + blog draft May 3; Grant bench data May 7; assets final May 10; Jules webhook & enrichment test by May 15; enable Slack & daily digest by May 18.
Rina (PartnerOps): confirmed — will send checklist today and request sandbox keys (dev-only, scoped). will ask partner PM for guest section by May 4.
Sana (Legal): Ill pre-clear consent language for sandbox access — send me the Kofi draft and the proposed trial terms.
DeployBot: Event created: StratusForge Integration Webinar on 2026-05-25 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Marketing, Sales Ops, PartnerOps.
Jules (Sales Ops): one more technical note: include a field "consent_for_enrichment" on the form to comply with GDPR. if false, skip Clearbit enrichment and route to a lower-touch nurture. Also include an allowlist check before issuing sandbox keys.
Kofi (Content): will include consent checkbox copy and EU privacy blurb; sending to Sana and Marta by May 3.
Grant (PMM): after webinar, track conversion MQL->SQL by partner_tag and promo_code usage. want analytics tag for STRATUS-TRIAL-30.
Marta (Growth): great. call out blockers here. if legal or sandbox access slips we delay demo slots but keep webinar live. :eyes:
